title: Multimodal data integration using machine learning improves risk stratification of high-grade serous ovarian cancer.
summary: Machine learning integrated clinical imaging and genomic data to stratify high-grade serous ovarian cancer risk using patient outcomes.
ai_technology: Machine learning integrates clinical, imaging and genomic features to stratify high-grade serous ovarian cancer risk.
organization: Computational Oncology; Weill Cornell/Rockefeller/Sloan Kettering Tri-Institutional MD-PhD Program

evidence.tested: The study reports outcome-based risk stratification using integrated multimodal patient data.
evidence.unknown: The retrospective study does not establish prospective clinical utility or treatment benefit.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning integrates clinical, imaging and genomic features to stratify high-grade serous ovarian cancer risk.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
